messages:
maria: Draft PRD for Optimize Toolkit (batching/caching/quant) is up — looking for acceptance criteria + final scope. Need alignment by EOD Tue so we can lock for Wed planning. Link: https://redwood.internal/prd/optimize-toolkit-draft
kevin: Thx. Quick q — target SLOs for hosted vs dedicated? we should call them out.
omar: Also need to enumerate model classes (chat, instruction-following, embeddings) and which quant modes we recommend. edge cases: small context windows + streaming.
emily: From product POV prioritize two customer lanes: 1) low-latency chat (interactive), 2) high-throughput embedding pipelines. Acceptance criteria should map to each lane.
noah: For runtime: include rollout gates: canary latency increase <= 5% and token-cost reduction >= 10% vs baseline. can run perf job.
maria: here's a quick acceptance checklist:
```
- lane: low-latency chat: p95 <= 120ms end-to-end for 8k seq
- lane: embeddings pipeline: throughput >= 2x baseline for 512-token batches
- quality: automated eval on 3 prompt sets, embedding-similarity delta within threshold
- regressions: no >1% top-line quality regressions per eval
- rollout: canary for 5% traffic, auto rollback on SLA breach
```
kevin: add quant safety: require per-model eval after quantization and explicit revert if >0.5% quality drop on critical prompts.
emily: Console UX ask — need a simple toggle + explainers for batching and cache risk (stale prefixes). I can mock microcopy.
omar: I can run a small sweep on 2 representative models (llama-2-70b, mosaic-13b) this week. ETA Fri. will post numbers.
maria: action items: @omar run sweep; @kevin add quant gating to PRD; @emily mockup console microcopy; @noah create canary job + perf baseline. Sync Thu 10am to finalize. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: perf-job/sweep scheduled by noah for 1965500000
